annotations.title: Get company data availability and freshness

description: A cheap stored-data manifest for one exact company: available datasets, latest reporting periods, actual ingestion/computation timestamps where stored, and cached relationship graph status. Call before deeper research when coverage or freshness is uncertain. This reads indexed metadata, not every research endpoint, and never starts enrichment. Availability is not completeness or accuracy. A null stored timestamp means freshness is unknown; a reporting period is not an ingestion date. Read-only.

ticker.description: Bullrun company ticker, e.g. AAPL, SAP or 6324.T. Bullrun tickers: US and most European listings use the plain local symbol (AAPL, BMW, NESN, ABBN); most Asian and Indian listings keep their exchange suffix (Tokyo 6324.T, Hong Kong 0700.HK, Shanghai 600519.SS, Shenzhen 000001.SZ, Taiwan 2330.TW, Korea 000100.KS, Singapore D05.SI, India RELIANCE.NS), but some Japanese and Korean large caps are plain codes (Toyota 7203, Samsung 005930). Either form is resolved automatically when exactly one listing matches; use search_stocks to find a ticker by company name or ISIN.
